subject: Custom data handoff & wipe playbook — timelines and verification
messages:
From: Arielle Jacobs <ari@meditechpartners.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Meditech Partners Legal <legal@meditechpartners.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Bespoke retention / wipe plan needed for pilot

Thanks Soojin — quick intro and context. We're preparing a short pilot (6 months) for a regulated workload that will process EHR-derived metadata. Our security and compliance team requires a documented handoff and wipe playbook that covers:
- Where data will be resident (region + short-term ephemeral persistence)
- Exact retention windows by data class (raw input, cached KV, embeddings, logs)
- Verification steps for deletion (certificates, proofs, or attestations)
- Escrow/handback process in the event of contract termination

Can you share a proposed timeline and the minimum verification artifacts Redwood will provide? I'm attaching a rough spec to illustrate our ask.

Attachments: Meditech_Custom_Retention_Spec_v1.pdf (application-level data matrix)

Arielle Jacobs
Head of Regulatory Programs
Meditech Partners
ari@meditechpartners.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Arielle Jacobs <ari@meditechpartners.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Meditech Partners Legal <legal@meditechpartners.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bespoke retention / wipe plan needed for pilot

Hi Arielle — thanks for the spec and the clear matrix. Looping in Marissa (customer success, pilot ops) and Rishi (security) so we can map our standard playbooks to your classes.

High level responses up front so you have something to review quickly:
1) Residency: we can guarantee US-only residency and pin model endpoints to a single region for the pilot.
2) Retention windows: we propose a two-tier approach — ephemeral KV cache (max 24 hours), session traces & logs (30 days), and embeddings/derived artifacts (configurable: 30/90/180 days).
3) Deletion verification: we can offer an encrypted-key revocation certificate (cryptographic erasure option) plus a signed deletion attestation issued by Redwood once the wipe completes. For more stringent needs we provide an independent forensic checksum snapshot prior to wipe and post-wipe attestations.
4) Handback/escrow: we can provide a staged handoff packaging (encrypted archive) plus a one-time secure transfer window; for longer term retention we can trigger an escrow export.

Two asks from us to finalize timelines:
- Can you confirm the maximum retention for embeddings you want during the pilot? (30/90/180)
- Do you require an independent third-party attestation or is an internal signed deletion certificate sufficient?

I'll put a concrete MAP (mutual action plan) draft in a follow-up and attach our handoff checklist.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
soojin@redwoodinference.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>, Arielle Jacobs <ari@meditechpartners.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Meditech Partners Legal <legal@meditechpartners.com>, Samir Qureshi <samir.qureshi@counsel.io>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 14:55:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bespoke retention / wipe plan needed for pilot

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 11:08 AM Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> High level responses up front so you have something to review quickly:

Quick technical note and options from our side (so legal/ops can decide):

Option A — Cryptographic erasure (fast, low ops):
- We execute key revocation for customer-specific encryption keys used to store embeddings/caches.
- Provides cryptographic evidence (revocation record) and reduces risk window to zero for encrypted objects.
- Limitations: requires usage of customer-dedicated keys for the dataset (we can provision this in Dedicated/Private tiers).

Option B — Verified zero-write deletion + audit log (comprehensive):
- We run a coordinated wipe across storage + index + KV caches during a pre-agreed maintenance window.
- We capture pre-wipe checksums and post-wipe proofs; an internal security engineer will sign the attestation.
- Offer an optional independent witness (third-party firm) for the attestation for an extra fee.

Operational timeline suggestions:
- Embeddings: choose 30/90/180 days. For 30-day flows we can schedule daily incremental garbage-collection with a final snapshot + wipe on t+1 business day after contract end.
- Logs & traces: standard 30-day retention with 14-day grace for forensic hold requests.

I've attached a checklist that outlines the exact verification artifacts we can supply and the estimated ops lead time (2–7 business days depending on option).

Attachments: handoff-checklist.xlsx

If you confirm embeddings window and attestation preference, we'll draft the order form language and the MAP with explicit dates.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Arielle Jacobs <ari@meditechpartners.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Meditech Partners Legal <legal@meditechpartners.com>, Samir Qureshi <samir.qureshi@counsel.io>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 16:43:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bespoke retention / wipe plan needed for pilot — MAP draft attached

Arielle — thanks for the fast responses. Per Rishi's options and your compliance constraints, attached is a short Mutual Action Plan and proposed order form language that we suggest including in the pilot SOW. Highlights: 
- Embeddings retention: 90 days (configurable), with daily incremental GC and final purge within 1 business day after termination when Option B chosen; for Option A we will provide key-revocation certificate within 24 hours of revoke.
- Verification: Redwood will provide internal signed deletion attestation; third-party witness is optional and will be priced separately.
- Handback: encrypted archive export available within 3 business days after request; transfer over SFTP or secure transfer link.
- Escrow: if requested, a scheduled escrow export will be completed within 10 business days.

Next steps: please confirm (a) embeddings retention window (we propose 90d), (b) whether you want third-party witness for deletion attestation, and (c) preferred handoff transfer method (SFTP vs. secure link).

If acceptable we'll convert the attached MAP into signed order form language and a short addendum to your pilot SOW.

Attachments: MAP_Meditech_Pilot_v1.docx (inline map), handoff-checklist.xlsx

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
